QuestInfo.name: Two Worlds
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta left for Maple World as the new Transcendents after breaking free of Mirror World. But what was it that landed them in Grandis?
QuestInfo.1: The Black Mage's minions offered a deal to become Transcendents of both Maple World and Grandis. His plan was clearly the domination of both worlds.
QuestInfo.2: Rash decisions never end well. Alpha and Beta finally started their true adventures.
